prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If object within reach, grab it, check properties, move robot, do task. If not, find object. list of available nodes: <Action ID = GrabObject    /> <Action ID = MoveRobot    /> <Condition ID = IsMissionComplete    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> <SubTree ID = CheckObjectProperties    /> <SubTree ID = SpecificTask    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectWithinReach    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectWithinReach? THEN
			DO GrabObject
	ELSE
		DO CheckObjectProperties
		DO MoveRobot
		DO SpecificTask
	END
